message.reasoning:
I am playing Monopoly as an AI player.

I have $686 and four properties but no monopolies. Player 1 has a dangerous dark blue monopoly with buildings. Player 3 owns three unconnected properties. Player 4 has a full set of railroads and utilities.

I will keep Tennessee to block Player 4's orange set. I have enough cash to pay Player 1's Boardwalk rent. No property sets are complete, so building is not an option.

I am considering trading Player 4 for St. James to complete an orange monopoly. Player 4 has $1712 and may not want to give up the property. I could offer cash plus another asset.

Player 1 has only $58, so they likely cannot build more houses on Boardwalk or Park Place. I will not give them cash. Player 4 previously rejected a $650 offer for St. James, so I need to find a better trade package.

A $400 offer for St. James would leave me with only $286. That is below the $600 Boardwalk rent, so I would need to mortgage a property to survive that landing. I am checking the mortgage values of my current holdings to see which one to use.

Mortgaging all four properties yields only $370, so a $400 offer for St. James would still leave me short of the $1400 rent if Player 4 builds three houses. I am now considering lowering my offer to $300, though Player 4 previously rejected a lower bid.

Re-offering St. James at $400 would waste a trade exchange, so that path is abandoned. Player 3 has no assets that complete a set for me. Player 1 still cannot build more houses on Boardwalk or Park Place.
